calls.input: A 54-year-old woman started ibuprofen 400 mg by mouth three times daily on 8 September 2026 for back pain. On 11 September she developed melena (black, tarry stools) and dizziness and was hospitalized. I suspect ibuprofen was related to the event. She received intravenous fluids, recovered, and was discharged on 13 September. There was no death, life-threatening event, disability, congenital anomaly, intervention to prevent permanent impairment, or other serious outcome.
